name: Mullaperiyar Dam — Periyar River (Kerala / Tamil Nadu)
description: 1895 lime-surkhi masonry gravity dam on the Periyar River in the Cardamom Hills, Idukki district, Kerala; operated by Tamil Nadu for trans-basin irrigation diversion to the Vaigai basin. Long-running inter-state safety dispute over the age of the structure and the permitted reservoir level. No dam failure has occurred; this is a hypothetical dam-break scenario over the real downstream terrain (Idukki reservoir / lower Periyar valley).

structure.construction_note: Lime-surkhi (burnt brick powder) mortar, rubble-faced; built by Col. John Pennycuick without Portland cement.

breach_event.discharge_source: No authoritative published dam-break peak-outflow figure adopted. Dam-break analyses exist in litigation filings but their peak-discharge numbers are contested and not used here. Operator must supply a breach hydrograph (or reservoir volume + breach geometry) before running.

simulation_defaults.breach_latlon_note: Public geographic reference for the dam location (Western Ghats, Idukki). Not a physics parameter.
